fact: The party ties up their boat at Gracklstugh after traveling across the Darklake.
source_quote: the party finally tied up their boat at the grim duergar city of Gracklstugh
subject: arrival at Gracklstugh

fact: Gracklstugh is a grim duergar city.
source_quote: the grim duergar city of Gracklstugh
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: A wave of acrid heat hits the party's faces upon arrival.
source_quote: A wave of acrid heat slammed against their faces
subject: arrival sensation

fact: The city features countless forges reflected in the dark water.
source_quote: the light of countless forges reflected off the dark water
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: The streets are noisy with smiths, merchants, and slaves.
source_quote: the rhythmic hammering of the city's smiths blended with the shouting of merchants and slaves
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: Drow, svirfneblin, derro, orcs, and other races are present in the crowds.
source_quote: Drow, svirfneblin, derro, orcs and other races moved through the crowds
subject: Gracklstugh residents

fact: Hemeth is a duergar arms dealer.
source_quote: Hemeth, the duergar arms dealer they had rescued
subject: Hemeth

fact: Hemeth warns the party that non-duergar are permitted only in the Darklake district.
source_quote: Hemeth... warned them that non-duergar were permitted only in the Darklake district
subject: Hemeth's warning

fact: The Darklake district is fully enclosed by walls.
source_quote: The district is fully enclosed by walls
subject: Darklake district

fact: Duergar guards can turn invisible at will.
source_quote: Guards who could turn invisible at will enforced a code
subject: duergar guards

fact: Theft in Gracklstugh is punishable by death on the spot without a trial.
source_quote: theft was punishable by death on the spot, no trial required
subject: city law

fact: Any duergar in sight counts as instant reinforcements.
source_quote: any duergar in sight counted as instant reinforcements
subject: duergar

fact: Corruption among the duergar is very rare.
source_quote: Corruption among them is very rare
subject: duergar

fact: If word spreads that the party are escaped slaves, slavers might repossess them or sell them back to the drow.
source_quote: if word got out they were escaped slaves, slavers might try to repossess them or sell them back to the drow
subject: slave status

fact: Thorin objects that they were merely temporarily detained, not slaves.
source_quote: Thorin objected that they had merely been "temporarily detained."
subject: Thorin

fact: The party aims to resupply with better weapons and armor.
source_quote: Their goals were clear: resupply with better weapons and armor
subject: party goals

fact: The party aims to find information leading them out of the Underdark.
source_quote: find information that might lead them out of the Underdark for good
subject: party goals

fact: The longer route runs from Gracklstugh to the lost tomb marked on the dwarf's map.
source_quote: The longer route ran from Gracklstugh to the lost tomb marked on the dwarf's map
subject: lost tomb

fact: Blingdenstone is a possible exit point from the Underdark.
source_quote: and from there to Blingdenstone, a possible exit point
subject: Blingdenstone

fact: The party decides to head to the Blade Bazaar to trade and purchase supplies.
source_quote: The party decides to head to the Blade Bazaar to trade and purchase supplies.
subject: Blade Bazaar
